children: Key Tronic Corp reported fiscal 2026 net sales of $386.67M, a decline from $467.87M in the prior year, and recorded a net loss of ($47.79M), or diluted loss per share of ($4.41), reflecting weaker legacy program demand and customer receivable write‑offs.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “loss per share — Diluted”.
Revenue declined 17.4% year-over-year as legacy and end-of-life programs waned despite ramps from new programs.
Company exited China operations, right-sized Mexico, and expanded production in the U.S. and Vietnam to diversify the supply chain and reduce tariff risk.
Secured more than $60M in new program awards in Q4 across medical, data center, automotive, industrial and power sectors.
Invested in capacity and capabilities—doubling its Vietnam footprint and opening a U.S. R&D/technology center in Arkansas to support engineering and program ramps.

Gross margins were compressed and results were affected by significant write-offs for distressed customer receivables and a related valuation allowance, prompting increased focus on collections and program mix.
